components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Sage pill button for primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6B705C; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'Quicksand', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #5a5f4e; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6B705C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip Selected
components.css: .ds-chip-selected { background: #6B705C; color: #ffffff; padding: 6px 16px; font-family: 'Quicksand', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0px 8px 32px -4px rgba(107, 112, 92, 0.12); transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-chip-selected:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Filter Chip Default
components.css: .ds-chip-default { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7); color: #A5A58D; padding: 6px 16px; font-family: 'Quicksand', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-chip-default:hover { background: rgba(221, 190, 169, 0.2); } .ds-chip-default:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

components.name: Input Pill
components.css: .ds-input-pill-wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); border: 1px solid rgba(165,165,141,0.1); border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0px 12px 48px -8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); overflow: hidden; } .ds-input-pill { flex: 1; height: 64px; background: transparent; border: none; padding: 0 32px; font-family: 'Quicksand', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; color: #6B705C; outline: none; } .ds-input-pill::placeholder { color: rgba(165,165,141,0.4); } .ds-input-pill-action { width: 48px; height: 48px; margin-right: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #6B705C; color: #fff; border: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s; } .ds-input-pill-action:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

narrative.overview: Zen Ledger feels like unbleached paper and clay: warm, rounded, quietly confident. Mobile-first, one-handed, bottom-weighted. Surfaces float with soft shadows; numbers use tabular precision inside friendly type.
keyCharacteristics: Warm oat background with 2% noise grain overlay
No pure black or white; sage and herb carry hierarchy
Pill inputs and chips; cards 24px–40px radius
Terracotta outflows, dusty green inflows; never punitive red
Custom SVG icons only; emoji for category identity

rules.name: The Calm Money Rule
rules.body: Never use pure red for debt or overspend. Terracotta and rose carry outflow semantics.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Sage is the only strong brand color on any screen.

rules.name: The Float Rule
rules.body: Only FAB, bottom nav, modals, and primary metric cards get heavy shadows.

rules.name: The No Side-Stripe Rule
rules.body: Never use colored left/right borders on cards or list items.

rules.name: The Number Alignment Rule
rules.body: All currency values use tabular-nums and Nunito 700–900.

dos: Do use Zen token classes from layout.css
Do keep bottom nav and FAB visible on all main routes
Do use active:scale-95 on tappable elements
Do animate modals at 400–600ms with ease-out curves
Do maintain WCAG AA contrast in both themes
donts: Don't use navy-and-gold fintech palettes or hero-metric templates
Don't add colored side-stripe borders on cards
Don't use gradient text for amounts or headings
Don't import Lucide or external icon libraries
Don't show punitive red or shame language for missed entries
Don't introduce off-palette colors like raw Tailwind blue on dashboard cards
